channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Nothing CEO announces upcoming AI hardware release for next month
item.description: The chief executive of Nothing stated that an artificial intelligence hardware product will launch next month. The device aims to enhance user productivity, though specific product details remain unconfirmed.

item.title: Palestinian and Israeli reactions differ following US midterm results
item.description: Citizens in Palestine and Israel have expressed mixed perspectives regarding the outcome of the recent United States congressional elections, which resulted in Democratic victories.

item.title: Arsenal defeats Slavia Prague despite late pressure in Champions League
item.description: Arsenal secured their third Champions League victory in four matches with goals from Noni Madueke and Victor Gyokeres. Slavia Prague mounted a late comeback attempt, but the English side held on for the win.

item.title: Fenerbahce overcomes deficit to defeat Liverpool in Champions League
item.description: Turkish club Fenerbahce overcame two deficits to secure a victory against Liverpool. The result concludes Liverpool's consecutive winning streak after four matches in the current tournament.

item.title: Late Valverde goal gives Real Madrid victory against AEK Athens
item.description: Real Madrid maintained their flawless record in the Champions League following a late goal by captain Federico Valverde. The outcome marks the third consecutive defeat for AEK Athens in the competition.

item.title: Manchester United stages second-half comeback to defeat Roma
item.description: Manchester United overcame a two-goal deficit after halftime to achieve a Champions League win against Roma at Old Trafford.

item.title: Barcelona hands Aston Villa first Champions League defeat via Raphinha
item.description: Barcelona halted Aston Villa's unblemished tournament record with a victory at the Spotify Nou Camp, driven by two goals from Raphinha.

item.title: Bayern Munich defeats Atletico Madrid to extend unbeaten run
item.description: Bayern Munich preserved their undefeated record in the current Champions League campaign by defeating Atletico Madrid 2-0 away from home.

item.title: Inter Milan defeats Feyenoord as Spence shines
item.description: Following a local derby loss, Inter Milan secured a decisive Champions League win against Feyenoord, aided by standout performances from English defender Djed Spence.

item.title: Uber reports minimal use of AI agents for bookings
item.description: Uber revealed that just four ride requests were made via artificial intelligence agents during the company's highest-traffic week of the previous quarter.

item.title: Snapchat subscription base exceeds 30 million users
item.description: Snapchat reached this milestone one year after restricting free Memories storage and introducing a $1.99 monthly fee alongside the broader Snapchat+ subscription.

item.title: Vance attributes midterm defeats to Iran conflict
item.description: JD Vance stated that the recent electoral losses suffered by Republicans were fundamentally driven by the war with Iran, noting the president acknowledged this as well.

item.title: LIV Golf faces closure following funding withdrawal
item.description: LIV Golf is expected to officially announce its termination on Thursday after its primary financial backer pulled out support.

item.title: Assessing bilateral ties after recent US election results
item.description: Analysis examines how the Republican party's recent electoral losses might impact diplomatic and strategic relations between India and the United States.

item.title: Alternative uses for massive capital expenditures
item.description: A satirical review explores numerous ways a massive sum of money could have been alternatively allocated instead of social media investments.

item.title: Court mandates schools to combat LGBTQ+ targeted bullying
item.description: Acting on a petition filed by the mother of a deceased student from a Faridabad school, the High Court ordered educational institutions to tackle harassment linked to gender identity.

item.title: Aston Villa Manager Unai Emery Targeted For Contract Extension
item.description: Aston Villa plans to offer manager Unai Emery a contract renewal. Meanwhile, Liverpool's Trey Nyoni is set to remain with the club amid links to Leeds regarding Harvey Elliott.

item.title: West Bengal: Eleven Tribals Detained Over Land Port Rehabilitation
item.description: Police arrested eleven tribal residents in West Bengal following a prolonged peaceful protest near a Land Ports Authority of India project site in Gotabari, Torsa Tea Garden.

item.title: OpenAI Executive Proposes AI Strategy Ahead Of 2028 US Election
item.description: OpenAI official Chris Lehane aims to integrate artificial intelligence into the 2028 election cycle. A proposed social contract seeks to assist citizens while supporting the company's commercial goals.

item.title: Online Platforms React To Democratic Party Victory In US Congress
item.description: Social media users shared widespread commentary following the Democratic Party's successful capture of the United States Congress.

item.title: Reviewer Shares Experience Adapting To A Striking Phone Grip
item.description: An editorial piece explores the growing popularity and eventual acceptance of a distinctive phone accessory shaped like a stick of butter, paired with a striped case.

item.title: British Currency Hits Ten-Year High Following Brexit Vote
item.description: The British pound climbed to its strongest value against a currency basket since the Brexit referendum took place nearly a decade ago.

item.title: Activist's Wife Criticizes Ladakh Officials Over HIAL School Delay
item.description: Activist Sonam Wangchuk's wife, Angmo, criticized Ladakh officials over halted kindergarten projects. The local administration stated the school opened without required official permissions.

item.title: NGO Reports Israeli Barriers For Over One Thousand Gaza Child Amputees
item.description: An NGO reports that Israeli travel limits and blocked medical transfers are stopping more than one thousand child amputees in Gaza from receiving treatment overseas.

item.title: Elf Beauty Raises Annual Outlook Following Strong Quarterly Sales
item.description: Elf Beauty reported a 51 percent surge in sales on Wednesday, beating expectations. The firm also upgraded its revenue projections for the entire fiscal year.

item.title: VMware Launches vSphere Express to Support Smaller Hardware Setups
item.description: VMware has introduced vSphere Express to accommodate virtualization needs on systems with up to 128 cores. Company executives stated the product responds directly to feedback from smaller clients.

item.title: Trump Cautions Democrats Against Impeachment Following Midterm Defeats
item.description: Following midterm electoral setbacks, Donald Trump cautioned that pursuing impeachment proceedings would harm the Democratic Party.

item.title: Remote Tech Worker Weighs City Move From Village Over Lifestyle
item.description: A remote software engineer earning Rs 1 lakh monthly in a quiet village is considering relocating to Kota. Despite financial success, limited weekend activities have made rural life monotonous.

item.title: Wyoming Court Grants Landowner Private Road Access for $61,200
item.description: Following unsuccessful negotiations, Wagonhound Land and Livestock secured legal permission for a private road to reach its 640-acre parcel. The Wyoming Supreme Court ruled the firm must pay $61,200 for the access.

item.title: Meta Buys AI Software Development Startup Conductor
item.description: Meta has purchased Conductor, an artificial intelligence startup that enables developers to run multiple autonomous agent teams on projects at the same time.

item.title: Painting Acquired for £500 Confirmed as Turner and Sold for £1.9m
item.description: An artwork bought for £500 in April 2024 was authenticated as an early piece by JMW Turner after restoration revealed his signature. The verified painting subsequently fetched nearly £1.9 million at auction.

item.title: Minister Rijiju Criticizes Congress Over Open Debate Demands
item.description: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju criticized Rahul Gandhi and other Congress members regarding their calls for an open debate with the prime minister, suggesting changes to their approach.

item.title: AMD Posts Record Revenue as Data Center Sales Surge Past Gaming Losses
item.description: AMD reached a record $13.4 billion in quarterly revenue, driven by a doubling of its data center division. Meanwhile, the company's gaming sector experienced a 40 percent drop.

item.title: First-Gen Bose QuietComfort Headphones Drop to $169.99 in Major Discount
item.description: Amazon, Best Buy, and Bose have slashed the price of first-generation Bose QuietComfort noise-canceling headphones to $169.99. This $190 discount matches the lowest price ever offered for the audio device.

item.title: US Midterm Elections Bring Democratic Gains as Trump Points to Iran Conflict
item.description: Democratic victories have transformed the American political sphere following the midterm elections. Former President Trump attributed the party's defeats to the war involving Iran, while numerous competitive contests remain undecided.

item.title: Musk's $47 Million PAC Donation Fails to Secure Texas Win
item.description: A political action committee backed by billionaire Elon Musk spent $47 million supporting Ken Paxton's campaign, which ultimately fell short in the midterm elections.

item.title: Telstra Issues Apology for Unexpected Phantom Missed Call Alerts
item.description: Telstra apologized for customer confusion caused by widespread phantom missed-call alerts sent to mobile phones. The telecommunications provider attributed the glitch to its MessageBank system.

item.title: Top US Congressional Democrats Celebrate Midterm Election Victories
item.description: The leading Democratic figures in both houses of the US Congress celebrated their party's major success in the midterm elections. Leaders praised the strong electoral results across the nation.

item.title: Israeli President Seeks Compromise Following Polarized National Election
item.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog started consultations with political chiefs to determine who will attempt to form a government. The discussions involve choosing between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and rival Gadi Eisenkot amid deep societal division.

item.title: Pia Dandiya Maintains Strong Family Bonds Following Florida Election Win
item.description: Pia Dandiya has maintained close connections to her family origins in Jaipur after securing an election victory in Florida.

item.title: Heavy Rainfall Hits Telangana's Bhadradri Region Due to Cyclone Murasu
item.description: Bhadradri experienced severe downpours on November 4 as a result of Cyclone Murasu affecting the state of Telangana.

item.title: Ancient Belt Buckle Found in Ukraine Points to Roman Era
item.description: An 1,800-year-old decorated belt buckle unearthed in a Ukrainian woodland likely belonged to a nomadic horse rider. Researchers note the Roman-era artifact suggests historical tensions between Rome and the Dacians.

item.title: Kyiv Claims Bodycam Footage Reveals Russian Double-Tap Strike
item.description: Following a Monday bombing in a Ukrainian village, officials report a minimum of 40 fatalities. Authorities indicate that up to 30 individuals might remain trapped underneath debris.

item.title: DreamHost Discloses Customer Data Breach in Prolonged Cyberattack
item.description: The web hosting provider reported that unauthorized actors leveraged a security flaw to gain entry to user files and email inboxes. This breach occurred over several months during a targeted intrusion.

item.title: মোবাইল অপারেটরদের তরঙ্গ ফি কমানোর এবং নমনীয়তার দাবি
item.description: নেটওয়ার্কের মান উন্নত করতে ও বিনিয়োগ বাড়াতে তরঙ্গ নবায়নের খরচ কমানোর আহ্বান জানিয়েছে মোবাইল অপারেটররা। বুধবার বনানীতে আয়োজিত অনুষ্ঠানে তারা ফি পরিশোধের শর্তেও নমনীয়তা প্রত্যাশা করে।

item.title: Zaporizhia Missile Strike Death Toll Rises to 40
item.description: Ukrainian authorities confirmed 40 deaths from a recent Russian attack in Komyshuvakha. Search and rescue operations continue at the site despite disruptions caused by Russian drones.

item.title: Wayfair Reports 10% Revenue Increase in Third Quarter
item.description: Furniture seller Wayfair experienced a 10 percent revenue rise during the third quarter. The company stated this performance marks its highest quarterly growth since the pandemic period.

item.title: Netanyahu Alleges Foreign Financing Interfered in Israeli Vote
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu asserted on Wednesday that foreign entities used substantial funds to manipulate the nation's recent parliamentary elections. He highlighted significant concerns regarding external electoral interference.

item.title: CVS Health announces plans to separate its retail pharmacy division
item.description: The healthcare corporation intends to undo its 2018 acquisition of Aetna by splitting off its drugstore operations, causing its stock price to drop by 10 percent.

item.title: South Africa Holds Municipal Elections in Major Political Test
item.description: South African citizens head to the polls for important local government elections that present a major challenge for the ruling ANC party. Meanwhile, Ethiopia expelled six Sudanese diplomats amid territorial dispute allegations.

item.title: Silicon Valley attributes voter opposition to AI as pro-Trump sentiment
item.description: Major technology firms argue that recent American voter initiatives limiting artificial intelligence and data infrastructure stem from political alignment rather than tech hostility.

item.title: McDonald's shares climb following strong financial results and domestic growth
item.description: Financial figures exceeded expectations as American locations showed progress. The fast-food chain recently utilized promotional discounts to draw in price-sensitive customers.

item.title: Index ranks Andhra and Kerala highest for vehicle ownership ease
item.description: A new study places Andhra Pradesh and Kerala at the top of vehicle ownership convenience, while Uttar Pradesh and Bihar occupy the lowest positions.

item.title: Iran prepares deterrence strategy amid uncertainty over potential US strikes
item.description: Tehran announces readiness with a maximum deterrence plan as questions remain regarding whether Washington will restart military attacks against the country.

item.title: Rajib Ghosh released at midnight as Iqbal Sobhan is arrested
item.description: Law enforcement detained former prime minister's media adviser Iqbal Sobhan Chowdhury and special correspondent Rajib Ghosh from a TV station office, with Ghosh later released.

item.title: Researchers identify strong signs of habitable Martian volcanic vents
item.description: Investigators discovered compelling indications that a major Martian volcano may feature magma and conditions once capable of supporting ancient life.

item.title: Trump Predicts Strong Outperformance in 2026 Midterms
item.description: The 2026 U.S. midterms involve roughly 210 million registered voters casting ballots for 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats, and 36 governorships. Donald Trump stated that the electoral outcome will exceed expectations.

item.title: Serbia detains police officers over alleged use of force against protesters
item.description: As reported by The Guardian, Interior ministry claims suspects tortured and intimidated protesters detained in garage of government compound Serbian authorities detained nine active police officers and one former officer on Wednesday for ⁠allegedly using excessive force against detainees…. Key points: Serbia, Interior, Serbian, Wednesday.

item.title: Manipur conflict inquiry commission receives sixth deadline extension
item.description: The panel investigating violence in Manipur has been granted another extension, moving its final report submission date to May 2027.

item.title: প্রথম আলোর ২৮তম প্রতিষ্ঠাবার্ষিকীতে ফুলেল শুভেচ্ছা
item.description: Prothom Alo-এর প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী, প্রথম আলোর ২৮তম প্রতিষ্ঠাবার্ষিকী ছিল ৪ নভেম্বর। এ উপলক্ষে রাজধানীর কারওয়ান বাজারে প্রথম আলো কার্যালয়ে আসেন বিভিন্ন করপোরেট প্রতিষ্ঠান, গণমাধ্যম, ব্যাংক, শিক্ষাপ্রতিষ্ঠান ও হকার সমিতির প্রতিনিধিরা। কারও হাতে ছিল ফুলের তোড়া, কারও হাতে কেক। ফুলেল শুভেচ্ছা, কেক…। এ ঘটনায় আলোচিত: প্রথম, ফুলেল, শুভেচ্ছা, প্রতিষ্ঠাবার্ষিকীতে।
